description: Merge PR #305 after verified current-develop integration, add 0.7.1 release notes/version, publish the Hex patch release, and tag the release.

comments.text: Release paused by user: Hex publication must not proceed. CI required two retries: initial release-package checks deterministically used hard-coded bedrock-0.7.0.tar after version bump (fixed in #310); subsequent S3 retry-telemetry test passed only on rerun (existing bedrock-uvk flake). Do not treat rerun-green CI as release verification.

Found the deterministic first-run CI defect: commit 0c922c0a deriving the Hex artifact name landed via #310 on main but was never returned to develop. PR #311, correctly based on develop, therefore still tries to extract bedrock-0.7.0.tar after building 0.7.1. Landing the workflow-only fix on develop before release verification.
